title: Bounds for the heap path value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean vector indexed by $0,�dots,n-1$, and let $o$ be a natural number. For each natural number $l$, form the heap path value by starting at $1$ and, at each step $j<l$, doubling the current value and adding the Boolean coordinate of $x$ at index $o+j$ (taking that coordinate to be false when $o+j\ge n$). Then this value lies in the interval $[2^l,2^{l+1})$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean vector $x$ indexed by the first $n$ natural numbers
The bounds hold for every natural number $l$
